skills.label: React
skills.last_signal: Profiling and state partitioning with numbers

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Tell me about the most technically challenging project you have worked on recently.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: A real-time dashboard with hundreds of updates per second.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: How was that state flowing before you changed anything?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Every websocket event went through Redux; profiling showed 80% of renders were unnecessary.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: What did the fix look like in production numbers?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Render count dropped 60% and p95 interaction time went from 400ms to 120ms.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: How did you keep the team aligned on that change?

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Thanks for your time, you will hear back from the team soon.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Thanks — one last thing: the rollout was gated behind a per-workspace feature flag.
